catalog.container_strategy: Build only in dev with an absolute selected-QBE path, exact assembler/linker/preprocessor closure and an isolated prefix. Target receives linked artifacts and declared runtime libraries only.

native_probe.scope: This native dev build only; not a container size prediction or transient peak measurement.

catalog.purpose: Feed real C programs into QBE, retain emitted IL, separate frontend legality from backend optimization, and enable C-to-native/bootstrap experiments.
qualification_gaps: Pinned author-maintained GitHub mirror is an admitted transport; canonical project is on SourceHut.
Language support is incomplete: inspect this pinned README for volatile, atomics, long double, PIC and preprocessor limitations before admitting datasets.
The configure step discovers host GCC startup files; cross-architecture builds require an explicit future sysroot/ABI adapter.
A complete bootstrap and C corpus suite are independent gates beyond the installation smoke.
catalog.size_basis: Complete HTTPS payload measured locally; source logical bytes sum regular archive members, excluding allocation, build trees and external dependencies.
catalog.title: cproc C frontend for QBE

recipe.dependency_refinement: Original binutils and libc6-dev dependencies use their exact complete catalog DEBs privately. The original build-essential compiler remains an observed host build tool; its cpp and libgcc-13-dev runtime components and their full exact catalog closure are privately retained and invoked. Original metadata.catalog and sources are unchanged. No host APT transaction or fabricated package state.

locations.purpose: The selected version's independently installed files.

notes: Set CPG_QBE_PREFIX to the separately managed exact QBE 1.3 build 2 binary dependency before direct invocation. Package-manager checks pass that dependency explicitly.

cproc driver/front-end are genuinely compiled from the fixed original C source and statically linked with the exact private headers/CRT/libc. Private cpp, binutils and runtime libraries are precompiled original Debian inputs.
Original source, full original DEBs and licenses remain inside each independently installed resource. Generated config.h changes and two original upstream suites plus bootstrap are recorded.

Qualified for the declared Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 developer host. Linked output executables use this prefix's private dynamic loader/library paths and must not be moved or outlive the installation without an explicit runtime export. No target export or cross-platform qualification is claimed.
